title: cyperus sylvaticus
intro: Cyperus sylvaticus, commonly known as Umbrella Sedge, is a perennial plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus sylvaticus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which can aid in relieving symptoms of bronchitis, asthma, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
